entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac... I hope you can help me. I need to return something and I'm just so disappointed about it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. It's a jersey. I've been a loyal customer for years and I've never had a problem like this.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Vent Performance Jersey from about two months ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

It's just the wrong size. I waited to try it on for a special event, and when I finally did... it's just way too tight in the shoulders. I really saved up for this one, and I feel so silly that I didn't check it sooner.
I completely understand, that can certainly be frustrating. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.

Alright, I've checked our policy. While it has been about 62 days, our standard apparel items have a 90-day return window. So, you are well within the timeframe. We can absolutely process this for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. I was worried I'd be stuck with it and I really needed that money back.
Not a problem at all. We can either process a full refund to your original payment method, or I can help you set up an exchange for the next size up. Which would you prefer?
A refund would be wonderful, thank you.

You got it. And I see here that you're a VIP member with us. As a thank you for your loyalty and for the sizing trouble, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just print it, attach it to the package, and drop it off.
Wow, that's so kind of you. You've really turned my day around, Isaac. I was so worried. Thank you!

It's my pleasure. You should see that email come through in the next few minutes. Once we receive the jersey, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
